name: Niyenin
description: Niyenin is a multi-vendor retail marketplace — sellers open their own stores, list products and fulfil orders, while shoppers buy from many vendors in one cart.
detail: Built as the retail-market monorepo. Vendors register and manage catalogues; admin handles approvals, commissions, payouts and reporting. Customers checkout across vendors in one flow. Live preview: niyenin-frontend.vercel.app.

stack.frontend: Next.js · React · TypeScript · Tailwind · Redux Toolkit · next-auth
stack.dashboard: Vite · React · React Router · Recharts · TipTap
